{{Quote|This 100,000 credit voucher is yours to use as you see fit, as long as you join the Alderbathe Monastery for life and give it all to them. Love, Grandpa.|A note from a grandfather to their grandchild|<ref name="HR" />}}
The '''Alderbathe Monastery'''<ref name="HR" /> was located in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Alderbathe system/Legends|Alderbathe system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{RPGseed}}
At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Unidentified grandfather|grandfather]] of one of a group of individuals addressed a note to their grandchild in which they bequeathed to them a [[credit voucher]] of one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. However&mdash;despite claiming that the grandchild was free to do with the [[Currency/Legends|money]] as they wished&mdash;the [[Gender/Legends|grandfather]] also noted that they had to join the Alderbathe Monastery for life and also give all the credits to them.<ref name="HR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Alderbathe Monastery was mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book mentions the monastery in an example [[in-universe]] message illustrating how a player character having received a special gift with "strings attached" could figure into the development of their backstory. This article assumes that situation plays out as described.<ref name="HR" />
